items.meta_description: Practical guides from VpnHood!: how to test your VPN speed properly, and more to come.
items.title: VpnHood! guides
items.lead: Short, practical answers to the questions people actually ask about running a VPN. No sales pitch, just the method.
items.art_alt: Three step cards rising along a route towards a finished marker
items.speed_title: How to test your VPN speed properly
items.speed_desc: Take a baseline, pick the server deliberately, and read the difference honestly.
items.split_title: What is split tunneling, and when should you use it?
items.split_desc: What it does, when it helps, what it costs, and which default fits your reason for using a VPN.
items.webrtc_title: Why can websites see my IP address through WebRTC?
items.webrtc_desc: A WebRTC test can show your device's own address while you are on a VPN. Why that is rarely a leak, and how to stop it in your browser.
items.google_title: How does Google know my location when I use a VPN?
items.google_desc: Where Google gets your location besides your internet address, why a shared server can point home, and what you can do.
items.see_title: What can a VPN see, and what does it keep?
items.see_desc: What any VPN server can see of your traffic, what VpnHood! CONNECT keeps, what a server's owner can do, and how to check it in our code.
